ja: 使う場所で追加効果が変化する攻撃。

key: The target is attacked with a slash. Critical hits land more easily.
en: The target is attacked with a slash. Critical hits land more easily.
ja: ツメやカマなどで相手をきりさいて攻撃する。急所にあたりやすい。

key: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.
en: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.
ja: するどくとがったつので相手を攻撃する。

key: The target is stomped with a big foot. It may make the foe flinch.
en: The target is stomped with a big foot. It may make the foe flinch.
ja: おおきなあしで相手をふみつけて攻撃する。相手をひるませることがある。

key: The user approaches the target, then steals the target's held item.
en: The user approaches the target, then steals the target's held item.
ja: かわいくあまえながら相手にちかづきもっている道具をうばう。

key: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join for more damage.
en: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join for more damage.
ja: うたで相手を攻撃する。みんなでりんしょうすると続けてだすことができ威力も上がる。

key: This attack does double damage on a paralyzed target. It cures the target's paralysis.
en: This attack does double damage on a paralyzed target. It cures the target's paralysis.
ja: まひ状態の相手には威力が２ばいになるがかわりに相手のまひが治る。

key: Star-shaped rays are shot at the opposing team. This attack never misses.
en: Star-shaped rays are shot at the opposing team. This attack never misses.
ja: ほしがたの光をはっしゃして相手を攻撃する。攻撃は必ず命中する。

key: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.
en: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.
ja: 相手をりょうがわからはさんでダメージを与える。

key: The target is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.
en: The target is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.
ja: カマやツメなどで相手をきりつけて攻撃する。

key: An attack that is used in desperation if the user has no PP. It also hurts the user.
en: An attack that is used in desperation if the user has no PP. It also hurts the user.
ja: 自分のＰＰがなくなるとあがいて相手を攻撃する。自分も少しダメージを受ける。

key: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its body.
en: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its body.
ja: 相手にむかって体ぜんたいでぶつかっていき攻撃する。

key: An attack move that varies in power and type depending on the weather.
en: An attack move that varies in power and type depending on the weather.
ja: 使ったときの天気によってわざのタイプと威力がかわる。

key: The user hits the target with an echoing voice. If used every turn, it is more powerful.
en: The user hits the target with an echoing voice. If used every turn, it is more powerful.
ja: ひびくこえで相手を攻撃する。まいターン誰かがわざをつかいつづけると威力が上がる。

key: This attack hits first and makes targets flinch. It only works on the user's first turn.
en: This attack hits first and makes targets flinch. It only works on the user's first turn.
ja: せんせい攻撃で相手をひるませる。戦闘にでたらすぐにださないとせいこうしない。

key: A restrained attack that leaves the target with at least 1 HP.
en: A restrained attack that leaves the target with at least 1 HP.
ja: 相手のＨＰが必ず１だけのこるようにてかげんして攻撃する。

key: Numerous coins are hurled at the target to inflict damage. Money is earned after battle.
en: Numerous coins are hurled at the target to inflict damage. Money is earned after battle.
ja: 相手の体にこばんをなげつけて攻撃する。戦闘のあとでおかねがもらえる。

key: The target is physically pounded with a long tail or a foreleg, etc.
en: The target is physically pounded with a long tail or a foreleg, etc.
ja: ながいしっぽやてなどをつかって相手をはたいて攻撃する。

key: The user slams the target at a tremendous speed. It is sure to strike first.
en: The user slams the target at a tremendous speed. It is sure to strike first.
ja: めにもとまらぬものすごいはやさで相手につっこむ。必ずせんせい攻撃できる。

key: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.
en: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.
ja: かたくとがったするどいツメで相手をひっかいて攻撃する。

key: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. It may also make the target flinch.
en: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. It may also make the target flinch.
ja: 自分がねているときにざつおんをだして攻撃する。相手をひるませることがある。

key: The user slams the target with a tail, vine, or tentacle. The target is hit twice.
en: The user slams the target with a tail, vine, or tentacle. The target is hit twice.
ja: しっぽなどをつかい相手をたたいて攻撃する。２かいれんぞくでダメージを与える。

key: An attack that hits a target using Protect or Detect. It lifts the effects of said moves.
en: An attack that hits a target using Protect or Detect. It lifts the effects of said moves.
ja: 守るやみきりなどをしている相手に攻撃ができる。まもりの効果をかいじょさせる。

key: The user strikes the target with its tail. It hits the Pokémon two to five times in a row.
en: The user strikes the target with its tail. It hits the Pokémon two to five times in a row.
ja: かたいしっぽで相手をたたいて攻撃する。２ー５かいのあいだれんぞくでだす。

key: While the move is in use, the user's rage raises the Attack stat when the user is hit.
en: While the move is in use, the user's rage raises the Attack stat when the user is hit.
ja: わざをだしたときに攻撃を受けるといかりの力で攻撃が上がる。

key: A spin attack that can also eliminate such moves as Bind, Wrap, Leech Seed, and Spikes.
en: A spin attack that can also eliminate such moves as Bind, Wrap, Leech Seed, and Spikes.
ja: かいてんして相手を攻撃する。しめつけるまきつくやどりぎのタネまきびしなどもふきとばせる。

key: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times.
en: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times.
ja: するどいハリを相手にはっしゃして攻撃する。２ー５かいのあいだれんぞくでだす。

key: The target is hit with a flurry of punches that strike two to five times in a row.
en: The target is hit with a flurry of punches that strike two to five times in a row.
ja: どとうのパンチで相手をなぐりつけて攻撃する。２ー５かいのあいだれんぞくでだす。

key: The target is raked with sharp claws or scythes for two to five times in quick succession.
en: The target is raked with sharp claws or scythes for two to five times in quick succession.
ja: ツメやカマなどで相手をひっかいて攻撃する。２ー５かいのあいだれんぞくでだす。

key: Round objects are hurled at the target to strike two to five times in a row.
en: Round objects are hurled at the target to strike two to five times in a row.
ja: まるいものを相手になげつけて攻撃する。２ー５かいのあいだれんぞくでだす。

key: Things such as long bodies or tentacles are used to bind the foe for four to five turns.
en: Things such as long bodies or tentacles are used to bind the foe for four to five turns.
ja: ながい体やつるなどをつかい４ー５ターンのあいだ相手をしめつけて攻撃する。

key: The target is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times in a row.
en: The target is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times in a row.
ja: おうふくビンタで相手をたたいて攻撃する。２ー５かいのあいだれんぞくでだす。

key: The target is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times in a row.
en: The target is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times in a row.
ja: つのやくちばしで相手をつついて攻撃する。２ー５かいのあいだれんぞくでだす。

key: A long body or vines are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.
en: A long body or vines are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.
ja: ながい体やつるなどをつかって４ー５ターンのあいだ相手にまきついて攻撃する。

key: The target is attacked with creeping tentacles or vines. It can lower the target's Speed.
en: The target is attacked with creeping tentacles or vines. It can lower the target's Speed.
ja: しょくしゅやツタなどをからみつけて攻撃する。相手の素早さを下げることがある。

key: The user endures for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.
en: The user endures for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.
ja: ２ターンのあいだ攻撃にたえて受けたダメージを２ばいにして相手にかえす。

key: The target is crushed. The greater the target's HP, the more powerful the attack.
en: The target is crushed. The greater the target's HP, the more powerful the attack.
ja: すさまじい力で相手をにぎりつぶす。相手のＨＰがのこっているほど威力が上がる。

key: An attack move that cuts down the target's HP to equal the user's HP.
en: An attack move that cuts down the target's HP to equal the user's HP.
ja: 相手のＨＰが自分のＨＰと同じくらいになるようにダメージを与える。

key: The user flails about to attack. It becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
en: The user flails about to attack. It becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
ja: じたばたあばれて攻撃する。自分のＨＰが少ないほどわざの威力は上がる。

key: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.
en: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.
ja: ふまんをはらすためぜんりょくで相手を攻撃する。なついていないほど威力は上がる。

key: A vicious attack with big pincers. The target will faint instantly if this attack hits.
en: A vicious attack with big pincers. The target will faint instantly if this attack hits.
ja: おおきなハサミで相手をきりさいて攻撃する。あたれば一撃でひんしにする。

key: A unique attack that varies in type depending on the Pokémon using it.
en: A unique attack that varies in type depending on the Pokémon using it.
ja: わざを使ったポケモンによってわざのタイプがかわる。

key: The user stabs the target with a rotating horn. If it hits, the target faints instantly.
en: The user stabs the target with a rotating horn. If it hits, the target faints instantly.
ja: かいてんするつのを相手につきさして攻撃する。あたれば一撃でひんしにする。

key: The user draws power from its held Berry. The Berry determines the type and power.
en: The user draws power from its held Berry. The Berry determines the type and power.
ja: きのみから力をもらい攻撃する。もたせたきのみでわざのタイプと威力がかわる。

key: The user attacks by giving the target a gift with a hidden trap. It restores HP sometimes.
en: The user attacks by giving the target a gift with a hidden trap. It restores HP sometimes.
ja: わなをしかけたはこを相手にわたして攻撃する。ＨＰが回復してしまうこともある。

key: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.
en: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.
ja: トレーナーのためにぜんりょくで相手を攻撃する。なついているほど威力は上がる。

key: The target is hit with a destructive shock wave that always inflicts 20 HP damage.
en: The target is hit with a destructive shock wave that always inflicts 20 HP damage.
ja: しょうげきはを相手にぶつけて攻撃する。２０のダメージをきまって与える。

key: The power stored by Stockpile is released. The more power stored, the greater the damage.
en: The power stored by Stockpile is released. The more power stored, the greater the damage.
ja: たくわえた力を相手にぶつけて攻撃する。たくわえているほど威力が上がる。

key: The user bites hard on the target with sharp front fangs. It cuts the target's HP to half.
en: The user bites hard on the target with sharp front fangs. It cuts the target's HP to half.
ja: するどいまえばではげしくかみついて攻撃する。相手のＨＰは半分になる。

key: The fewer PP this move has, the greater its attack power.
en: The fewer PP this move has, the greater its attack power.
ja: きりふだののこりＰＰがすくなければ少ないほどわざの威力が上がる。

key: The user wrings the target. The more HP the target has, the greater this attack's power.
en: The user wrings the target. The more HP the target has, the greater this attack's power.
ja: 強くしめあげて攻撃をする。相手のＨＰがのこっているほど威力は上がる。

key: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its stats.
en: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its stats.
ja: つぼおしで体をかっせいかさせる。能力のどれか１つをぐーんと上げる。

key: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.
en: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.
ja: 相手の行動をサポートして自分の行動のあとに続けてうごけるようにする。

key: The user randomly uses a move among those known by other Pokémon in the party.
en: The user randomly uses a move among those known by other Pokémon in the party.
ja: 多いそぎで味方のたすけをかりて味方のポケモンがおぼえているわざをどれか１つ使う。

key: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated.
en: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated.
ja: ♂なら♀を♀なら♂をゆうわくしてメロメロにする。相手はわざがだしにくくなる。

key: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, passing along any stat changes.
en: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, passing along any stat changes.
ja: ひかえのポケモンといれかわる。能力変化はかわったポケモンがそのままうけつぐ。

key: The user maximizes its Attack stat in exchange for HP equal to half its max HP.
en: The user maximizes its Attack stat in exchange for HP equal to half its max HP.
ja: 自分のＨＰを最大ＨＰの半分へらして自分の攻撃を最大に上げる。

key: The user passes its held item to the target when the target isn't holding an item.
en: The user passes its held item to the target when the target isn't holding an item.
ja: 相手が道具をもっていないとき自分がもっている道具を相手にわたす。

key: The user blocks the target's way with arms spread wide to prevent escape.
en: The user blocks the target's way with arms spread wide to prevent escape.
ja: りょうてをひろげてたちはだかり相手のにげみちをふさいでにげられなくする。

key: The user's type is changed depending on its environment.
en: The user's type is changed depending on its environment.
ja: みずべやくさむらどうくつなどいる場所にあわせて自分のタイプをかえる。

key: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target's Sp. Atk stat is lowered.
en: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target's Sp. Atk stat is lowered.
ja: ♂なら♀を♀なら♂をゆうわくして相手の特攻をがくっと下げる。

key: The user gazes at the target, making it less wary. The target's Attack is harshly lowered.
en: The user gazes at the target, making it less wary. The target's Attack is harshly lowered.
ja: かわいくみつめてゆだんをさそい相手の攻撃をがくっと下げる。

key: The user changes its type to become the same type as one of its moves.
en: The user changes its type to become the same type as one of its moves.
ja: 自分のタイプをおぼえているわざでいちばんうえのわざと同じタイプにする。

key: The user changes to a resistant type of the attack the opponent used last.
en: The user changes to a resistant type of the attack the opponent used last.
ja: 相手がさいごに使ったわざにていこうできるように自分のタイプを変化させる。

key: The user mimics the move used immediately before it.
en: The user mimics the move used immediately before it.
ja: ちょくぜんにでたわざをまねして同じわざをだす。わざがでていないとしっぱいする。

key: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.
en: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.
ja: 体をまるめてちぢこまり自分の防御を上げる。

key: For four turns, this move prevents the target from using the move it last used.
en: For four turns, this move prevents the target from using the move it last used.
ja: 相手のうごきをとめてちょくぜんにだしていたわざを４ターンのあいだつかえなくする。

key: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.
en: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.
ja: すばやいうごきでぶんしんをつくり相手をまどわせてかいひりつを上げる。

key: The user compels the target to keep using only the move it last used for three turns.
en: The user compels the target to keep using only the move it last used for three turns.
ja: 相手がさいごに使ったわざを３ターンのあいだずっとださせる。

key: The user endures any attack. Its chance of failing is greater if used in succession.
en: The user endures any attack. Its chance of failing is greater if used in succession.
ja: 攻撃をうけてもＨＰを必ず１だけのこせる。れんぞくでだすとしっぱいしやすい。

key: The user dances and compels the target to mimic it, making the target's Ability identical.
en: The user dances and compels the target to mimic it, making the target's Ability identical.
ja: ふしぎなリズムでおどる。うごきをまねさせて自分と相手の特性を同じにする。

key: The user's flashing light cuts the target's accuracy. It can be used to illuminate caves.
en: The user's flashing light cuts the target's accuracy. It can be used to illuminate caves.
ja: まぶしい光で相手の命中率を下げる。

key: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.
en: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.
ja: ふかくいきをすいきあいをこめる。自分の攻撃が急所に当たりやすくなる。

key: The user draws attention to itself, making all targets take aim only at the user.
en: The user draws attention to itself, making all targets take aim only at the user.
ja: 自分にちゅうもくさせて相手からの攻撃を全て自分にむけさせる。

key: Identifies an evasive or Ghost-type target.
en: Identifies an evasive or Ghost-type target.
ja: ゴーストタイプに効果がないわざやかいひりつのたかい相手に攻撃が当たるようになる。

key: The user intimidates the target with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.
en: The user intimidates the target with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.
ja: おなかのもようでおびえさせて相手をまひの状態にする。

key: The user growls, making the opposing team less wary. The foes' Attack stats are lowered.
en: The user growls, making the opposing team less wary. The foes' Attack stats are lowered.
ja: かわいいなきごえをきかせてきをひきゆだんをさせて相手の攻撃を下げる。

key: The user's body grows all at once, raising the Atk and Sp. Atk stats.
en: The user's body grows all at once, raising the Atk and Sp. Atk stats.
ja: 体をいっきに大きくせいちょうさせて攻撃と特攻を上げる。

key: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.
en: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.
ja: ぜんしんに力をこめて体をかたくして自分の防御を上げる。

key: The user makes a soothing bell chime to heal the status problems of all party Pokémon.
en: The user makes a soothing bell chime to heal the status problems of all party Pokémon.
ja: ここちよいすずのねいろをきかせて味方全員の状態いじょうを回復する。

key: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of its attack.
en: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of its attack.
ja: なかまをたすける。てだすけされたポケモンのわざの威力はいつもより大きくなる。

key: The user howls loudly to raise its spirit, boosting its Attack stat.
en: The user howls loudly to raise its spirit, boosting its Attack stat.
ja: おおごえでほえてきあいをたかめ自分の攻撃を上げる。

key: Leers with sharp eyes. The opposing team's Defense stats are reduced.
en: Leers with sharp eyes. The opposing team's Defense stats are reduced.
ja: するどいめつきでおびえさせて相手の防御を下げる。

key: The user takes sure aim at the target. It ensures the next attack does not miss.
en: The user takes sure aim at the target. It ensures the next attack does not miss.
ja: しょうじゅんをしっかりあわせてつぎの攻撃が必ず相手に当たるようにする。

key: The user tries to force a kiss on the target. If it suceeds, the target falls asleep.
en: The user tries to force a kiss on the target. If it suceeds, the target falls asleep.
ja: おそろしいかおでキスをせまる。相手を眠り状態にする。

key: The user chants toward the sky, preventing opposing Pokémon from landing critical hits.
en: The user chants toward the sky, preventing opposing Pokémon from landing critical hits.
ja: てんにむかっておいのりをささげ５ターンのあいだ相手の攻撃を急所にあたらなくする。

key: The user cuts ahead of the target to use its intended move with greater power.
en: The user cuts ahead of the target to use its intended move with greater power.
ja: 威力をあげて相手がだそうとするわざをさきにだす。さきにだせないとしっぱいする。

key: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.
en: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.
ja: すいこまれるようなくろいまなざしでじっとみつめて相手を戦闘からにげられなくする。

key: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.
en: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.
ja: ゆびをふり自分ののうをしげきして全てのわざのなかからどれか１つをくりだす。

key: The user restores its HP by up to half of its maximum. May be used in the field to heal.
en: The user restores its HP by up to half of its maximum. May be used in the field to heal.
ja: 最大ＨＰの半分自分のＨＰを回復する。

key: The user copies the target's last move and adds it to its move-set until it is switched out.
en: The user copies the target's last move and adds it to its move-set until it is switched out.
ja: 相手がさいごに使ったわざを戦闘のあいだ自分のわざにすることができる。

key: The user senses the target's movements with its mind to ensure its next attack hits.
en: The user senses the target's movements with its mind to ensure its next attack hits.
ja: 相手のうごきをこころでかんじてつぎの攻撃が必ず相手に当たるようにする。

key: The user compresses its body to look smaller, which sharply raises its evasiveness.
en: The user compresses its body to look smaller, which sharply raises its evasiveness.
ja: 体をちぢめてちいさくみせて自分のかいひりつをぐーんと上げる。

key: An attack that makes use of the user's environment.
en: An attack that makes use of the user's environment.
ja: しぜんの力で攻撃する。使う場所ででてくるわざが変化する。

key: Enables Ghost-types to be hit by Normal and Fighting-type moves.
en: Enables Ghost-types  to be hit by Normal and Fighting-type moves.
ja: ゴーストタイプに効果がないわざやかいひりつのたかい相手に攻撃が当たるようになる。

key: The user adds its HP to the target's HP, then shares the combined HP with the target.
en: The user adds its HP to the target's HP, then shares the combined HP with the target.
ja: 自分のＨＰと相手のＨＰをあわせてそれを自分と相手でなかよくわける。

key: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.
en: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.
ja: うたをきいたポケモンは３ターンたつとひんしになる。交代すると効果はなくなる。

key: It lets the user evade a move. Its chance of failing rises if used in succession.
en: It lets the user evade a move. Its chance of failing rises if used in succession.
